summary: Iteration 71 (live preview presence + talk-to-build sync rule) verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 PASS, 1 skipped (talk-to-build LLM test — current demo project has no files generated yet, so skipped per spec). All three new HTTP endpoints (POST /presence/heartbeat, DELETE /presence, GET /chats/{cid}/preview-viewers) work per spec: single-user heartbeat returns ok:true others:[]; DELETE clears the row and a follow-up heartbeat upserts it; cross-workspace heartbeat correctly 404s (tenant isolation enforced via workspace_id filter); preview-viewers 404s for unknown chats, returns {viewers:[],project_id:null} for chats with no linked project, and resolves the project via dev_projects.related_chat_id fallback when chat.linked_dev_project_id is missing; multi-user `others` filter excludes the caller and includes a seeded peer (verified by direct Mongo seed); a presence row with last_seen_at=now-120s is excluded from /others (90s TTL holds). Talk-to-build prompt edit was verified by inspection (services/dev_os_codegen.py:721 has explicit FRONTEND ↔ BACKEND SYNC RULE; edits cap raised from [:3] → [:4] at line 792). Frontend: DevStudio fires POST /presence/heartbeat within ~1s of mount and DELETE /presence on route change (both observed in network); CoViewersChip [data-testid=ds-co-viewers] is correctly hidden for single demo user, and renders with 'PD · Priya Demo is viewing' when a peer row is seeded. PreviewViewersChip [data-testid=chat-preview-viewers-chip] renders in the chat header with text 'Priya Demo is viewing the live preview · Join them', and the Join link [data-testid=chat-preview-viewers-open] resolves to /dev-os/projects/{pid}/studio.

minor.issue: DevStudio fires TWO heartbeats on initial mount (and TWO DELETEs on unmount) — likely React 18 StrictMode double-effect in dev. Harmless (the upsert is idempotent and the DELETE on a missing row is a no-op) but worth noting; in prod build with StrictMode off this collapses to 1.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/dev_os.py:_live_viewers — string-comparison TTL works only because timestamps are normalized ISO-8601 with timezone via now_iso(). If any code path ever writes a naive datetime or a different format (e.g. .strftime without microseconds), the $gte string compare silently breaks. Safer to store last_seen_at as a real BSON datetime and let Mongo do the comparison; the .isoformat() cutoff would then become a datetime as well.

routes/dev_os.py:presence_heartbeat — no rate-limit. A misbehaving client could heartbeat in a tight loop and write-amplify the dev_preview_presence collection. Consider a minimum interval (e.g. ignore writes when last_seen_at is <5s old) or a Mongo TTL index on last_seen_at so stale rows clean themselves.

pages/dev_os/DevStudio.jsx — heartbeat effect lacks a guard for 401/403 responses; if the user's session expires while in DevStudio, the interval continues to fire failing POSTs every 30s. Suggest stopping the interval after 2 consecutive non-2xx responses.

components/chat/PreviewViewersChip.jsx — 15s poll runs even when the chat tab is in the background. setVisibility-aware polling (Page Visibility API) would cut idle traffic ~60% for users who keep many chats open.
